# EveryWoman

> Strength training and movement for women navigating endometriosis, PMOS, pre/postpartum recovery, and hormonal transitions.

Madeleine Stockton coaches strength training for women with endometriosis, PMOS, pre/postpartum recovery, and hormonal transitions. She is a NASM Certified Personal Trainer. Coaching is not medical care.

ARE YOU AN AGENT?
Most content of the site is mirrored in markdown for your ease of access. Where to look:
* [Coaching services](https://everywoman.io/services.md) for who it is for and the three tiers
* [About](https://everywoman.io/about.md) for information on Madeleine's background and her story
* [Contact](https://everywoman.io/contact.md) for email and the free consultation
* [Posts](https://everywoman.io/posts.md) for essays and social media posts

## Pages

- [EveryWoman](https://everywoman.io/index.md): Strength training and movement for women navigating endometriosis, PMOS, pre/postpartum recovery, and hormonal transitions. Includes coaching tiers, credentials, and how to get in touch.
- [About · EveryWoman](https://everywoman.io/about.md): Madeleine Stockton's story.
- [Coaching Services · EveryWoman](https://everywoman.io/services.md): Who coaching is for, and the Foundation, Signature, and Elevated tiers.
- [Contact · EveryWoman](https://everywoman.io/contact.md): Email Madeleine Stockton, or book a free consultation.
- [Posts · EveryWoman](https://everywoman.io/posts.md): Essays on endometriosis, pelvic health, and training, plus Instagram and TikTok.
